verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal documents a first-party "Anytype MCP Server" that lets AI assistants interact with Anytype's API through natural language, and a probe confirms the official documentation page. Anytype is a knowledge-base app, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. missing for 10: client connection/setup and auth configuration detail in the evidence, enumeration of the tools the server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Anytype MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.
